description: This file defines the class Vtiger_PackageImport, which provides an API to import modules into the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for parsing manifest files, validating and extracting package contents, and importing various module components such as tables, blocks, fields, views, sharing access, events, actions, related lists, links, and cron jobs.

classes.name: Vtiger_PackageImport
classes.description: A class providing API methods to import modules into vtiger CRM, including parsing package manifests, validating package contents, and importing components such as tables, fields, views, and related data.

methods.name: __parseManifestFile
methods.description: Parses the manifest XML file from the package zip archive.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the package as specified in the manifest.

methods.name: xpath
methods.description: Performs XPath query on the parsed manifest XML.

methods.name: xpath_value
methods.description: Retrieves a specific value from XPath query result.

methods.name: isLanguageType
methods.description: Checks if the package is a language type package.

methods.name: isModuleBundle
methods.description: Checks whether the package zip contains a module bundle.

methods.name: getAvailableModuleInfoFromModuleBundle
methods.description: Returns the list of dependent modules in a module bundle.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Retrieves the license text of the package.

methods.name: checkZip
methods.description: Validates the package zip file by checking for manifest and required files.

methods.name: getModuleNameFromZip
methods.description: Extracts the module name from the package zip file.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name as specified in the manifest.

methods.name: initImport
methods.description: Initializes the import process by unzipping selected parts of the package.

methods.name: getTemporaryFilePath
methods.description: Generates a temporary file path for extraction.

methods.name: getDependentVtigerVersion
methods.description: Returns the required vtiger version dependency.

methods.name: getDependentMaxVtigerVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported vtiger version dependency.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the package version.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Main method to import a module zip into the system, handling dependencies and sequence.

methods.name: import_Module
methods.description: Imports core module data including tables, blocks, fields, views, permissions, events, actions, etc.

methods.name: import_Tables
methods.description: Imports database tables associated with the module.

methods.name: import_Blocks
methods.description: Imports blocks (sections) of the module.

methods.name: import_Block
methods.description: Imports a single block (section) into the module.

methods.name: import_Fields
methods.description: Imports fields within a block.

methods.name: import_Field
methods.description: Imports a single field and its properties.

methods.name: import_CustomViews
methods.description: Imports custom view/filter configurations.

methods.name: import_CustomView
methods.description: Imports a specific custom view configuration.

methods.name: import_SharingAccess
methods.description: Imports default sharing access settings.

methods.name: import_Events
methods.description: Imports event handlers associated with the module.

methods.name: import_Event
methods.description: Registers a specific event handler.

methods.name: import_Actions
methods.description: Imports module actions (buttons, tools).

methods.name: import_Action
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific action.

methods.name: import_RelatedLists
methods.description: Imports related list configurations between modules.

methods.name: import_Relatedlist
methods.description: Sets up a related module list for the module.

methods.name: import_CustomLinks
methods.description: Imports custom links for the module.

methods.name: import_CronTasks
methods.description: Registers scheduled cron jobs for the module.
